method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; no regulative rule, because the provisions encoded put no duty with a deadline on the claimant (NOTES.md); no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. The first encoding of this Act in Commons. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999, Compilation No. 70, compilation date 24 August 2026 (includes amendments: Act No. 68, 2025; register id C2026C00369), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00485.txt (retrieved 13 October 2026). Not deposited: the Administrative Decisions (Judicial Review) Act 1977 own meaning of person aggrieved and time limits; the Federal Court of Australia Act 1976 Part IVA.

seat: the individual bringing a claim about a contravention of the Act: an Australian citizen or resident whose interests are affected or who works for the environment (injunction, s 475); a person acting for an environmental organisation (ss 475(1)(c), 488); a landholder bound by a conservation agreement (s 476); a person seeking judicial review (s 487); a person who suffered loss or damage from a contravention (s 500)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run epbc-claims-dates.l4 ; l4 run epbc-claims.l4 ; l4 run epbc-claims-cases.l4
checks.result: 73 assertions written, 73 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text. One expectation changed in a scratch copy was reported as failing.

scope: Part 17 Division 14: ss 475, 476 (with s 307), 477, 479, 480 by its effect; s 480A(5) by its effect; Part 17 Division 16: ss 487, 488; Part 18: s 499(3), s 500, s 501 by its effect. Out: the rest of the Act (Part 3 prohibitions, approvals, permits, listing), remediation orders and determinations (ss 480A-480N), civil penalties and undertakings (Divisions 15, 15A), information notices (Division 15B), s 499(1), (2), (4); representative proceedings (other Acts). Reasons in NOTES.md.
focus: the provisions a claimant meets: injunctions for contraventions (interested persons, organisations, conservation agreements), extended standing for judicial review, and compensation for loss or damage caused by a contravention
